description_en: Modifies the pipeline management method of a specified Logstash instance
description_zh: 修改指定Logstash实例的管道管理方式
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch update-pipeline-management-config --instance-id ls-cn-oew1qbgl0000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --endpoints http://es-cn-n6w1o1x0w001c0000.elasticsearch.aliyuncs.com:9200 --user-name elastic --password xxxx --pipeline-ids testKibanaManagement --pipeline-management-type ES --es-instance-id es-cn-n6w1o1x0w001c0000 --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePipelineManagementConfig

parameters.help_en: A unique token used to ensure idempotency of the request. The client generates this value. It must be unique across different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The list of access addresses of the Elasticsearch instance where Kibana resides after Kibana pipeline management is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 开启Kibana管理管道后，Kibana所在Elasticsearch实例的访问地址列表
parameters.name: endpoints

parameters.help_en: The username for logging on to Kibana
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The password for logging on to Kibana
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The list of pipelines managed by Kibana
parameters.name: pipeline_ids

parameters.help_en:
The pipeline management method. Valid values:

ES: Kibana pipeline management.
MULTIPLE_PIPELINE: configuration file management
parameters.help_zh:
管道管理方式，可选值：

ES：Kibana管道管理
MULTIPLE_PIPELINE：配置文件管理
parameters.name: pipeline_management_type

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The information about the associated Elasticsearch instance
v1_body_parameters.name: body
